questions.source_content:
E-PROCUREMENT TENDER NOTICE
Office of the District Collector & District Magistrate, Dungarpur
Date: 1 January 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/208)
Subject: Enforcement of Highway Traffic Safety Rules and E-Challan Monitoring Drive (Phase-1)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Dungarpur division are hereby informed that under 'Enforcement of Highway Traffic Safety Rules and E-Challan Monitoring Drive', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 6 January in the central playground wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #308) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Dungarpur, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and playground movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Dungarpur), 2. Budget Reconciliation #118, 3. Digital Indexing.
Superintending Engineer
Dinesh Kumar Gurjar
solution_steps: 1. Go to INSERT -> Header/Footer and Page Number.
2. Go to DESIGN -> Watermark (and Page Border).

Dinesh Kumar Gurjar
